activate_neftune_on_model: activate NEFTune noisy embeddings on a model with a specified noise alpha value
deactivate_neftune_on_model: deactivate NEFTune noisy embeddings on a model using the returned hook handle
add_neftune_forward_hook: add a NEFTune forward hook to embedding layers to inject training noise
activate_neftune_with_accelerator: activate NEFTune on a model with a distributed training accelerator instance
deactivate_neftune_with_accelerator: deactivate NEFTune on a model with a distributed training accelerator instance
